lessons_used: Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Home wait_info (4 of 6 tests) and sign-in hint (5 of 10 tests) changes were helpful.
Finish new_flow changes were helpful, winning 2 of 4 tests.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, home redesign, adoption redesign, adoption incentive, and home new_screen changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

candidates.title: Companion Desktop Launch Practice Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive desktop pet launch practice sub-flow on the finish screen where users can test moving, hiding, and interacting with their companion before landing on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support emails show 3 users reporting pets failing to display on desktop and 3 users unclear on controls. Finish step has an 80.1% completion rate with room to improve initial usability.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive practice component to home_intro within onboarding scope without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses ~20% of users; support emails report control and display issues. Finish new_flow won 2/4 past tests (+3.3% average), but adding an interactive sub-flow requires new UI/release.

candidates.title: Account Existing Pet Recovery Security Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that logging into an existing account instantly recovers previously created pets and desktop settings.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in. Sign-in hints have historically won 5 out of 10 tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your original account automatically restores all previously created desktop pets and data.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint on the sign-in screen explaining pet recovery without modifying pricing or data requests.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in has high completion (92.4%) but top support issue (8 emails). Sign-in hint changes have strong track record (5/10 wins, +2.2% avg) and are simple text/config updates.

candidates.title: Companion Hatching Live Countdown Wait Indicator
candidates.change: Adds an estimated completion timer and visual progress indicator to the waiting screen while the desktop pet is rendering in the background.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s). Past tests show home wait_info changes succeeded in 4 out of 6 tests.

guard.reason: Adds an estimated timer for a real background rendering process on the waiting screen, which is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home step has extreme wait times (mean 2336s). Wait_info changes on home won 4 of 6 tests (+2.0% average gain).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Verification Checklist Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the photo upload area into a split checklist layout that verifies facial clarity, lighting, and background details before submission.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest funnel bottleneck at 66.0% conversion, and 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failures.

photo_upload.text: Check lighting, face view, and image clarity

guard.reason: replacement for 'upload_photos.photo_upload' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['photo_picker'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control Dock Finish Redesign
candidates.change: Reconstructs the home intro completion screen into a stage layout featuring a quick control dock preview for desktop pet shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 confusion, 4 bug) describe difficulty controlling or interacting with the pet after completing onboarding.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Path Selection Save State Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Shows a reassuring hint during path selection stating that path choices are safe and can be changed or expanded anytime later.
candidates.why: Choose_path step shows high average duration (mean 514s), suggesting users hesitate when choosing a companion path.

choose_path.hint: Your selection is saved to your profile and can be modified anytime in app settings after setup.

guard.reason: Adds a persistent selection hint on choose_path without removing choices or introducing dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path loses ~20% with high mean duration (514s), but support evidence is missing. Choose_path hints show mild positive historical lift (+0.5% across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Hatch Completion Desktop Notification Switch
candidates.change: Adds an explicit system notification toggle to the waiting screen so users can be notified immediately when background rendering finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes a long time (mean 2336s). Giving users a system notification option prevents abandonments during background rendering.

components.text: Notify me when my pet finish rendering on desktop

guard.reason: Adds an optional notification toggle component on the waiting screen during pet rendering.

candidates.score_note: Targets long wait step (2336s mean). Home notifications showed strong +3.5% average lift in 2 past tests, though evidence base is moderately small.

candidates.title: Companion Adoption Contract Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a new confirmation screen prior to certificate issue summarizing pet traits and configuration choices.
candidates.why: Adoption drops off significantly (66.0% completion). Creating a dedicated confirmation moment strengthens user intent before finishing adoption.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_adoption_summary']

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Session Recovery Headline Copy
candidates.change: Updates the sign-in screen headline and body copy to emphasize fast account sync and restoring existing desktop pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-authenticating; clear copy reassures users logging back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Use your account email to instantly synchronize existing pets, traits, and desktop settings.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Companion Hide & Show Quick Shortcut Hint
candidates.change: Displays a key shortcut tip on the finish screen showing how to toggle the pet on and off the desktop keyboard controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion over how to hide or summon the desktop companion once setup completes.

home_intro.hint: Pro Tip: Press Option+Space (or Alt+Space) anytime on your desktop to summon or hide your pet.

guard.reason: Adds a keyboard shortcut hint component to the home_intro screen within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses ~20% and 3 support tickets complain about controls. Low cost text hint, but finish hints lack specific historical benchmark data.
